summary: Full E2E testing of Owl Finance - React 19 + FastAPI + MongoDB. Admin and Client flows tested. 17/19 backend tests passed. Frontend works well with minor UX issues. Critical bug found: bcrypt/passlib hash inconsistency causing password update failures. Test environment data corruption when backend tests run against live DB.

critical.issue: CRITICAL: bcrypt/passlib generates password hashes via API endpoints that fail verification. Admin password created at startup works fine. But password updated via API endpoints (update_client, update_profile) creates hashes that cannot be verified. This causes client login to return 401 'Email ou senha incorretos' after any password update. Root cause: passlib shows 'bcrypt version' AttributeError at startup ('module bcrypt has no attribute __about__') - the bcrypt module may be in broken state for async context calls.

minor.issue: Test environment: when running backend tests against live DB, deleting test clients somehow causes owltest@test.com sample transactions to be deleted. Cannot fully reproduce. Possible race condition or cursor issue in delete_many.

ui_bugs.issue: On page load, the 'Bem-vindo ao Owl Finance!' toast notification (top-right) overlaps the 'Novo Cliente' button (also top-right). Button is unclickable for ~4-5 seconds until toast disappears.

issues: Overall design is excellent - dark mode theme, animated bubbles on client dashboard, gradient buttons all look professional and polished

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix bcrypt/passlib version incompatibility. Consider using `bcrypt` directly instead of passlib: `import bcrypt; bcrypt.hashpw(password.encode(), bcrypt.gensalt()).decode()`. Or upgrade bcrypt package to fix the '__about__' AttributeError. The issue is passlib cannot detect the bcrypt version, which may affect hash generation.
Move the 'Novo Cliente' button to a different position OR use a different placement for the toast to avoid overlap. Consider using bottom-right position for success toasts.
Backend tests should not run against the live database for CRUD operations. Consider using test credentials or a separate test DB.
critical_code_review_comments: CRITICAL: hash_password() is a sync function using passlib bcrypt which may produce inconsistent hashes in async FastAPI context. Consider replacing with: `import bcrypt; return bcrypt.hashpw(password.encode(), bcrypt.gensalt()).decode()` and verifying with `bcrypt.checkpw(plain.encode(), hashed.encode())`
The delete_client endpoint deletes all transactions of a client. This works but is irreversible. Consider soft-delete instead.
Password reset via admin API is broken (creates unverifiable hashes) - this means admin cannot reset client passwords.

success_rate.backend: 89% (17/19 tests pass - 2 fail due to bcrypt hash corruption after test run)
success_rate.frontend: 95% (all flows work: admin dashboard, client dashboard, CRUD for profits/expenses, upload page, histórico, perfil, sidebar, logout, protected routes; minor toast overlap issue)

seed_data_creation: Had to reseed 5 transactions for owltest@test.com (deleted during backend tests). Also had to reset owltest password directly in MongoDB (API-generated hashes are broken). Set plan back to 'Profissional'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The bcrypt/passlib issue is the #1 priority bug. owltest@test.com password must be reset directly in MongoDB (not via API) using passlib locally. Backend test `test_create_and_delete_client` somehow deletes owltest transactions - run backend tests carefully. The frontend works correctly when data is intact. Admin dashboard, client dashboard, all CRUD modals, sidebar navigation, and logout all tested and working.

bcrypt_hash_bug.symptom: After updating password via PUT /admin/clients/{id} or PUT /client/profile, login fails with 401
bcrypt_hash_bug.root_cause: passlib library shows 'AttributeError: module bcrypt has no attribute __about__' at startup. This indicates bcrypt version incompatibility with passlib. The hash creation may work but uses a different internal algorithm/settings than expected, causing verification failures in some execution contexts.
bcrypt_hash_bug.reproduction: 1. Login as admin, 2. Update owltest password via admin API, 3. Try to login as owltest -> 401
bcrypt_hash_bug.mitigation: Replace passlib with direct bcrypt: `import bcrypt; pwd_hash = bcrypt.hashpw(password.encode(), bcrypt.gensalt()).decode(); valid = bcrypt.checkpw(plain.encode(), hash.encode())`
